visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a baseball stadium's spectator stands under bright daylight. A man wearing a black cap and shirt is positioned in the foreground, holding a professional speed gun with a camcorder mounted on top. He is focused on the game. A small picture-in-picture window in the bottom right corner shows a pitcher on a baseball mound. (2) A close-up view focuses on the specialized scouting equipment: a Stalker Sport Pro IIs speed gun and a Panasonic camcorder held firmly by a scout. The scout's hands are clearly visible as he operates the device. (3) The camera pans across the scouting section of the stands. Several men are sitting at long tables, some recording with smartphones and others observing the field. The background shows a dense crowd of fans, many wearing yellow clothing. (4) A medium shot captures another scout from a different angle, using a speed gun that has a smartphone attached to it for recording. He is wearing a striped shirt. The stadium background is slightly blurred with bright natural lighting. (5) The final shot is a wide view of the stadium seating area, packed with hundreds of spectators. The pitcher remains visible in the picture-in-picture window at the bottom right. The overall setting is an professional outdoor baseball stadium during a daytime match.

(2) The rhythmic music continues at a steady 128 BPM tempo. The ambient stadium noise remains constant, characterized by distant cheering and the open-air frequency profile of a large outdoor venue.
